subject: a compact trumpet peeling open in one continuous strip
pose: bell facing forward while the body coils around it
art_direction: 一支短胖喇叭像橘皮般旋开，外铜内紫的连续螺旋露出空心结构，造型活泼。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Design a short broad trumpet whose metal body peels away in one continuous spiral, like the rind of an orange. The bell faces the viewer and anchors the silhouette, while the peeled strip curls around its side to reveal a violet enamel interior. Preserve a few compact valve forms so the instrument remains recognizable, but omit any lettering or decorative music marks. Use warm brushed brass outside and saturated violet inside, with precise edge reflections and small machining details. Set it against deep slate-blue, allowing the central bell to catch a cream highlight. Keep the coil compact and all curves within a circular crop, creating an exuberant object rather than a long horizontal instrument.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
